verdict.rationale: Databricks' Trust Center compliance page documents a SOC 2 Type II report available to customers and refers to a broader certification portfolio. That gives security reviewers a first-party attestation source, but the evidence names only SOC 2; HIPAA and PCI are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of HIPAA and PCI DSS attestations, detail on how customers obtain the reports, and independent corroboration.
